mapper.sql: scoped.work_calendar_id, scoped.company_id, scoped.location_id, scoped.calendar_code, version.work_calendar_version_id, version.version_number, version.calendar_name, version.calendar_year, version.time_zone_snapshot, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM calendar_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id ) THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE ( SELECT state_fact.state FROM calendar_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ) END AS status, version.effective_from, version.effective_to, version.snapshot_digest, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_calendar_version lineage WHERE lineage.work_calendar_id = version.work_calendar_id AND lineage.effective_from = version.effective_from AND lineage.supersedes_work_calendar_version_id IS NOT NULL AND lineage.version_number <= version.version_number ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM calendar_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id ) AS row_version, version.change_reason, scoped.created_by, scoped.created_at, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.actor_id FROM calendar_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_by ) AS updated_by, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.recorded_at FROM calendar_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_at ) AS updated_at

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.work_calendar_id) FROM work_calendar scoped JOIN work_calendar_version version ON version.work_calendar_id = scoped.work_calendar_id AND version.version_number = ( SELECT MAX(latest.version_number) FROM work_calendar_version latest WHERE latest.work_calendar_id = scoped.work_calendar_id ) JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = #{principalId} JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND (#{companyId} IS NULL OR scoped.company_id = #{companyId})
AND version.calendar_year = #{year}
